title: Compatible finite prefixes of codimension resolution rules
statement:
Let $\mathscr C$ consist of reduced Noetherian quasi-excellent schemes $X$ over $\mathbf Q$, including the empty scheme and finite disjoint unions [def-pc-reduced-scheme] [pqf-def-locnoeth] [def-exc-excellent-ring]; these are the inputs of [def-per-qe-ordinary-resolution-rule]. Its morphisms are all regular morphisms [def-per-regular-scheme-morphism]. Noetherian means a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings. Quasi-excellence means quasi-excellence of every affine coordinate ring. Put $c_X(x)=\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}$, the supremum of finite prime-chain lengths. Use ordinary finite blowup towers and ideal-preserving contracted pullback comparisons [def-trf-ordinary-resolution-rule] [def-nagata-global-blowup], with coherent centers [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $T(A)$ be the unresolved set of [def-per-resolution-strata]: the union of the image of the terminal singular locus and the images of all center singular loci, where singular means that the local ring is not regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Define resolution through codimension $r$ by closedness of $T(A)$ and $c_X(x)\le r\Rightarrow x\notin T(A)$. A center is equicodimensional over $X$ of codimension $e$ if every generic point of an irreducible component of its image has $c_X=e$, and the center is schematically dense over those generic image points in the sense of [def-per-resolution-strata] (a section whose germs vanish at every point over them is zero). Agreement off $T$ means that the restrictions to $X\setminus T$ have a common ordered ordinary tower after deleting exactly empty centers, with all surviving extended ideals retained.

For $d\in\mathbf N$, a codimension resolution prefix consists of rules $R_0,\ldots,R_d$ on $\mathscr C$. It satisfies: $R_0(X)$ has length zero; every ambient scheme of $R_r(X)$ is reduced Noetherian quasi-excellent; its centers are coherent, nonempty, reduced, nowhere dense, and equicodimensional over $X$ of some codimension $e\le r$; and it resolves through codimension $r$. For every regular $Y\to X$, $R_r(Y)$ is the contracted scheme-theoretic pullback of $R_r(X)$, deleting exactly the empty centers. For $r\le s\le d$, $T(R_s(X))\subseteq T(R_r(X))$, the two towers agree off $T(R_r(X))$ with the ordered ideals, and each center of $R_s(X)$ of $X$-codimension greater than $r$ lies over $T(R_r(X))$. A compatible codimension resolution construction is a family $P_d$ of such prefixes for every $d\ge0$, where $P_{d+1}$ retains every rule of $P_d$ unchanged. Its associated sequence has $r$th rule equal to the last rule of $P_r$. These are definitions, with no existence or stabilization assertion.
